subject: Aurelia AWS solution partner listing — visibility & entitlement handover
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@aurelia-analytics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Nambiar <priya@aurelia-analytics.com>, AWS Partner Rep <amy.kon@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick list for AWS listing & partner visibility

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. Aurelia is excited to get listed with AWS — our engineering team has finished the connector and we want to clear the visibility and entitlement requirements so we can start co-selling. Can you send the definitive evidence checklist (certs/telemetry examples/entitlement mapping) and any templates you prefer for the MPA? Also, what does the typical timeline look like for a sandbox -> public listing on Redwood/AWS?

We have a security contact (Priya) and an internal product owner who will be available for docs.

Appreciate it,
Samir
Founder, Aurelia Analytics
attachments: aurelia-demo-recording.mp4 (stub)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurelia-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick list for AWS listing & partner visibility

Hi Samir — great to meet earlier.

Short answer: I attached our visibility & entitlement checklist and a draft MPA we typically use for early co-sell. At a high level:
- Sandbox listing (private verifier + joint demo) => 2–3 weeks once we have entitlements and a working demo.
- Public listing + AWS co-sell enablement => usually 4–8 weeks, depends on evidence packaging and AWS RM availability.

Next steps for you:
1) Fill the attached checklist with the telemetry & entitlement mappings (we marked where we need example logs).
2) Sign the attached MPA draft or send redline (we usually keep a short cycle for early partners).
3) Share short demo clip + test account for our Solutions Engineers.

Looping in Ben and Karthik to align on co-sell ops and technical evidence. Olga, can you confirm whether we need any additional AWS-specific SKU mapping for Aurelia?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
attachments: visibility-entitlement-checklist.xlsx, Aurelia_Redwood_MPA_draft.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 03 Jul 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick list for AWS listing & partner visibility

Marissa — I reviewed the checklist draft you sent. A few operational notes we should call out to Aurelia:
- We need a sample of their billing event stream (30 days) or a test harness if they don't have production traffic. This helps us validate SKU routing and attribution.
- For co-sell enablement with AWS RM, they must provide a cleared marketing asset (one-pager + joint demo script). We can draft the one-pager with their copy.
- For entitlement mapping, we prefer a CSV export of entitlement IDs; otherwise our intake team will do a manual mapping which adds ~1 week.

Karthik — can you own the AWS engagement (intro to RM and required metering hooks)? Olga — flag anything on catalog-side that would block listing.

Ben
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Jul 2029 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick list for AWS listing & partner visibility

Will do. Action items from my side:
- I'll put Aurelia on the RM intro thread and request a co-sell intake slot (aiming for next Wed).
- I'll attach our SKU mapping template and ask Aurelia to return it populated; I'll also call out acceptable telemetry formats.
- I'll book a 30-min tech alignment with Aurelia's engineering and our Solutions team (tentative: Fri 5th).

Ben/Marissa: any preferences for legal on the MPA? We typically ask for a 2-week review window; if Aurelia needs a faster turnaround we can offer a 48–72 hour SLA with a short credit hold.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurelia-analytics.com>
Cc: Priya Nambiar <priya@aurelia-analytics.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, AWS Partner Rep <amy.kon@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jul 2029 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick list for AWS listing & partner visibility

Hi Samir / Priya —

Following up with the consolidated onboarding pack. Attached: (1) visibility-entitlement-checklist.xlsx with inline notes on examples we need, (2) Aurelia_Redwood_MPA_draft.pdf, and (3) aurelia-aws-evidence.zip containing telemetry sample templates and a sample billing-event CSV for mapping.

Operational timeline we expect:
- This week: Aurelia returns checklist + SKU mapping CSV.
- Week of Jul 15: tech alignment + RM intro; sandbox joint demo by Jul 19 if mapping is done.
- Target public listing & co-sell enablement window: Aug 12–30 (contingent on evidence completeness).

If you prefer, I can schedule a 30-min weekly sync during onboarding — recommend Tue mornings PT.

Thanks all — excited to get this over the finish line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
